title: Call an LLM API from the Terminal in 30 Seconds
description:
Chatting with AI is easy. Calling it from your own code? Just one web request. 💻

✅ POST to the Claude API with curl and your key
✅ Send your question as JSON
✅ Pipe the reply through jq to read the answer

Day 1 of Build AI Apps. Next up: Day 2, Stream a Response Token by Token.
Follow for a new short every day and ship your own AI app.

comment: Curl or Python: which would you call it from? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: keep your key in the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable instead of pasting it into the script.
